name: duopore-public-distraction-pattern-count
description: Counts user-recorded interruptions by your category and context labels and sums explicitly entered minutes. Reports repeated categories without diagnosis, psychological profiling or reading communications. Supply simple labels rather than raw chats or sensitive information. Uses only adult user-controlled facts; review the result. No external lookup, storage or sending.

interface.longDescription: Counts user-recorded interruptions by your category and context labels and sums explicitly entered minutes. Reports repeated categories without diagnosis, psychological profiling or reading communications. Supply simple labels rather than raw chats or sensitive information. Uses only adult user-controlled facts; review the result. No external lookup, storage or sending. Uses explicitly supplied structured inputs. Server computations are transient; the standalone website computes locally in your browser. Review the output before exporting it. No persistent account records, external source retrieval, sending, transactions or paid model calls. CSV/JSON review and export are available on the standalone website. MCP requests are capped at 128 KiB and computed responses at 256 KiB; individual field and record limits also apply.
